input.sql: SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(SUM(duration_min)) AS minutes FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS months FROM trips

SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(CAST(duration_min + 0.999999 AS INTEGER)) AS billed_minutes, SUM(MAX(CAST(duration_min + 0.999999 AS INTEGER) - 45, 0)) AS minutes_over_45, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_minutes FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type ORDER BY rideable_type
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS months, MIN(ride_date) AS first_ride, MAX(ride_date) AS last_ride, COUNT(*) AS rides FROM trips

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_rides, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN CAST(duration_min + 0.999999 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type <> 'electric_bike' THEN CAST(duration_min + 0.999999 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS classic_minutes, SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type <> 'electric_bike' THEN MAX(CAST(duration_min + 0.999999 AS INTEGER) - 45, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS classic_over_45 FROM trips GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week DESC LIMIT 8
